title: Importer

commands.report: 8 integration tests pass; import.test.mjs covers I01-I05 on a real temp Store and real files

tests: I01 only channel:<type>:outbound records import; admin/account/route keys ignored
I01 imported accounts are notification-only (controlEnabled=false), views carry no secret values
I02 unreadable/bad-JSON/prototype-key/no-supported input is skipped with a reason and writes nothing
I02 incomplete records are skipped whole; unknown fields dropped and reported
I03 preview and apply leave the source file bytes unchanged
I04 identical re-import is idempotent (already-imported, no duplicate account)
I04 a changed file is a new fingerprint (possible-duplicate), never an overwrite
I05 hash mismatch/missing hash is CONFLICT/VALIDATION and never pollutes the new store
